note: Identity-only projection of the WP1 Phase 0 live capture. Names, provider ids, team abbreviations and provider position labels only -- every statistic and every game/economic field is dropped. Used offline as the BALLDONTLIE subject directory.
provenance_note: NOT AN L1 FIXTURE AND NOT LEVEL-1 EVIDENCE. `providers/fixtures/record.py` reserves CAPTURED for verbatim provider response bytes written by capture_live(); this file is a projection of such a capture with every statistic removed, so calling it CAPTURED would claim an evidence tier it cannot support. It is stated explicitly rather than inferred, because the one thing this repository never lets a fixture do is imply its own origin.
